senses.definition: done with delicacy and skill
examples: a job requiring nice measurements with a micrometer

senses.definition: excessively fastidious and easily disgusted
examples: too nice about his food to take to camp cooking
so squeamish he would only touch the toilet handle with his elbow

senses.definition: exhibiting courtesy and politeness
pleasant or pleasing or agreeable in nature or appearance
examples: what a nice fellow you are and we all thought you so nasty

the corn and tomatoes are nice today

senses.definition: socially or conventionally correct; refined or virtuous
in a nice way
(ecology) the status of an organism within its environment and community (affecting its survival as a species)
a position particularly well suited to the person who or organization which occupies it
examples: he found his niche in the academic world

senses.definition: a small concavity
an enclosure that is set back or indented
a descriptive name for a place or thing
examples: the nickname for the U.S. Constitution is ‘Old Ironsides’

senses.definition: a familiar name for a person (often a shortened version of a person's given name)
examples: Joe's mother would not use his nickname and always called him Joseph

senses.definition: give a nickname to
a daughter of your brother or sister
being on the left side
examples: the near or nigh horse is the one on the left
the animal's left side is its near or nigh side

senses.definition: not far distant in time or space or degree or circumstances
examples: a near hit by the bomb

senses.definition: (of actions or states) slightly short of or not quite accomplished; all but
examples: the baby was almost asleep when the alarm sounded
the car all but ran her down

senses.definition: near in time or place or relationship
examples: as the wedding day drew near
don't shoot until they come near

don't get too close to the fire

senses.definition: a period of ignorance or backwardness or gloom
a shortening of nightfall
examples: they worked from morning to night

senses.definition: darkness

the period spent sleeping

senses.definition: the activity of people seeking nighttime diversion (as at the theater, a nightclub, etc.)
examples: in the summer the nightlife shifts to the dance clubs

senses.definition: the entertainment available to people seeking nighttime diversion

senses.definition: a situation resembling a terrifying dream

being one more than eight
